items.title: UnoGPT

While recent MLE agents show promise in automating pipeline design, they have been studied almost exclusively in fully supervised settings, leaving them untested ...

items.summary: Coding agents tackle successive tasks on an evolving repository, carrying forward edits and writing memory before the next task is known. items.title: Jensen Huang’s departure blasts big hole in AI startup funding, VCs and founders say
items.title_cn: 风险投资家和创始人表示，黄仁勋的离职导致人工智能初创公司资金出现巨大缺口
items.summary: Nvidia poured tens of billions into AI startups under Huang. Without him at the helm, founders and VCs are bracing for smaller checks and lower valuations.
items.summary_cn: 英伟达向黄仁勋领导下的人工智能初创公司投入了数百亿美元。没有他的掌舵，创始人和风险投资公司将面临较小的支票和较低的估值。
items.comment: 新趋势值得注意，别盲目跟风，适合自己的才是最好的。

items.title: US government grounds all flights across the United States ‘due to extraordinary circumstances’
items.title_cn: “由于特殊情况”，美国政府停飞全美所有航班
items.summary: A spokesperson for the FAA told TechCrunch that it issued the ground stop "following communication issues impacting multiple Air Route Traffic Control Centers," which manage the airspace across the United States.
items.summary_cn: 美国联邦航空局的一位发言人告诉 TechCrunch，“在影响管理美国空域的多个航线交通控制中心的通信问题之后”，该局发布了地面停车令。
